skill_name: Compare and contrast Jane Austen and Charlotte Bronte's writing styles.
workflow: Jane Austen and Charlotte Bronte were two of the most prolific authors of the 19th century. While both authors wrote novels with a focus on the interests and concerns of their time, their writing styles were distinct. Austen’s novels were more subtle in their characterization and drama with a focus on manners and dialogue.
